title: ICER Church Website
description: Institutional website for ICER Church — events, community content, and admin-managed media with a responsive public experience.
challenges: Split frontend/API deployment, MongoDB-backed auth when enabled, and file uploads stored on the server with URLs in the database.

title: SlideSong
description: Web app to import song lyrics (PDF, DOCX, TXT, or links from Letras.mus and Cifra Club), detect hymns automatically, edit verses and chorus, and export slide decks (PPTX, PDF, ODP). Integrates third-party APIs: Pexels for background images and optional lyric import from Letras.mus and Cifra Club.
challenges: Reliable lyric parsing across formats, third-party API integration (Pexels image search with daily per-IP limits; Letras.mus and Cifra Club URL import with graceful fallback when layouts change), and a 3-step wizard (import → edit with live preview → export) with batch ZIP generation.

title: JWT Auth API
description: Authentication demo with login and a JWT-protected profile — includes a live route in this portfolio (HS256 signed in the browser, token in sessionStorage) and a standalone Express + vanilla UI implementation on GitHub.
challenges: Secure token rotation, bcrypt password hashing, Redis-backed session revocation and consistent error contracts across endpoints.

title: ACS Inspector
description: Test automation for ACS — REST suites with Vitest, browser flows with Cypress, helper scripts and a browsable HTML checklist report.
challenges: Stable OAuth/API configuration, meaningful assertions across views and filters, and keeping generated checklist artifacts easy to review and share.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Single-page developer portfolio with light/dark theme, section-based navigation, and JSON-driven content for easy maintenance.
challenges: Consistent theming, smooth hash navigation between sections, and a layout that stays readable on both large monitors and small mobile screens.

title: SimpleBackup
description: Cross-platform backup app for non-technical users — protects documents, photos, and chosen folders with guided setup and plain-language status, without backing up programs, cache, or the entire user profile.
challenges: Rust backup engine shared with a Tauri desktop UI, sensible default include/exclude rules, and low resource usage during scheduled copies on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
